Approve with following conditions:
1. That all windows maintain a 2:1 height-to-width ratio and be limited to two
types: regular size and small size; and
2. Additional windows be installed on the right elevation;
3. That the siding material reflects a 6-inch reveal in the four elevations; and
4. That the double front door be simplified to a single, standard door; and
5. That the garage be detached;
6. That any adjustments made to the drawings be submitted to the Development
Services Department prior to the issuance of a Certificate of Appropriateness.
